description: Bench S6, the balance reference (D-026, M3 step 7): two equal lines of 8 warriors march into each other head-on, mirror images of each other. Equal forces should win about equally often; batch reports who won, how it ended, how long it took and how many men a squad had lost when it broke, and BalanceReferenceTests pins those numbers. Don't edit it to play: a change here moves the reference.
